candidates.change_summary: Replace the unconditional assignment to MinSum with an assignment that only happens when intitalized is false (no other behavior) — effectively makes SetMinSum have no effect if intitalized is true (same as original revert behavior but uses conditional instead of revert).
Replace the assignment to MinSum by adding 1 to the provided value before setting MinSum (changes observable stored value).
Replace the assignment to MinSum by multiplying the provided value by 2 before setting MinSum (changes observable stored value).
Replace the assignment to MinSum with setting it to zero regardless of input (observable difference).

Replace the early revert guard with an unconditional revert after setting MinSum (still sets MinSum but then reverts, making the external observed state unchanged — this changes observable behavior because original sets and returns while mutant always reverts and the call fails).
Removed the initialization check so MinSum is always set regardless of intitalized.
Inverted the initialization check so MinSum can only be set when already initialized.
Added a requirement that only nonzero values can be set for MinSum, preserving the original initialization guard.

Delay assignment by swapping statement order: set intitalized flag to true before assigning MinSum, after the initialization guard (so subsequent calls behave differently only if reentrancy or external observation occurs).
Assign MinSum to twice the provided value while preserving the initialization guard.
